## Usage

```{r setup}
library(metaboapp)
exdata_path <- list.files(
  system.file(package = "metaboapp", "extdata"),
  "example_data.csv",
  full.names = TRUE
)
```


## Load and clean data

`ReadFile()` expects a wide-format dataset where the rows are samples and
columns are metabolites.

```{r}
read.csv(exdata_path)[1:10, 1:5]
```

Using the `Sample` column and the "_" and "-" delimiters, it infers groups,
subgroups, separation methods (IP/HILIC/T3Acidic), and batches. It also pivots
the data from wide to long or tidy form for the rest of the analysis.

```{r}
(mdata <- ReadFile(exdata_path))
```

## QC

`metaboapp` comes with a few QC functions. `FilterBlanks()` runs blank filtering
to remove data points from samples that fail to meet a specified fold-change
threshold. To identify the data that get blank filtered without running the
filtering, use `GetBlankDropTable()`. `QCData` is a top-level function that
calls `FilterBlanks()` and removes metabolites with low variance. Use
`PlotMissingness` to get a presence/absence heatmap of your data.

```{r}
qc_data <- QCData(mdata)
mheatmap <- PlotMissingness(qc_data)
rm_data <- RemoveMissing(qc_data)
```

To examine your data before and after QC, you can use PCA:

```{r fig.ncol = 3}
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
PlotPCA(GetPCA(mdata)) + ggtitle("Raw")
PlotPCA(GetPCA(qc_data))+ ggtitle("QC")
PlotPCA(GetPCA(rm_data))+ ggtitle("Missingness removed")
```

## Imputation

```{r}
imputed_data <- impute.QRILC(rm_data)
```

## Model fitting

```{r}
groups <- unique(imputed_data$Group)

results <- DiffMetabolites(imputed_data)

PlotVolcano(results, groups[c(1, 5)], contrastTitle = "Example")
PlotAllVolcanoes(results, groups[c(1:3)], contrastTitle = "Example") |>
  wrap_plots()
```

## Pipeline

```r
fc_data <- ReadFile(exdata_path) |>
  QCData() |>
  RemoveMissing() |>
  impute.QRILC() |>
  DiffMetabolites(groups = groups[1:2])
```
